title: Demo deep-link entry strands dashboard in Loading — Dashboard refetch is gated on NotAsked
detail: enter_demo marks vacancies/dashboard_stats Loading for deep-link routes (VacancyDetail, ApplicationDetail, Archived, Comparison, Edit) whose entry effects never fetch the list. Later Dashboard navigation skips the fetch because vacancies is Loading, not NotAsked — dashboard spinner forever.
recommended_fix: In demo_entry_effects, also fire demo_api.list_vacancies for deep-linked routes (or set vacancies: NotAsked in enter_demo for non-dashboard routes) so the NotAsked-gated refetch can fire.

title: VacancyEdit demo deep link never fires get_for_edit, contradicting the enter_demo comment
evidence:
is_demo_route admits edit deep links and enter_demo claims the form loads:
    routes.VacancyEdit(id)
    | routes.VacancyHandoff(id) -> string.starts_with(id, "v-")
...
          // A deep-linked demo edit page needs its id set so the
          // get_for_edit response is accepted and the form can load.
          vacancy_edit_id: edit_id,

but demo_entry_effects has no VacancyEdit arm — it falls through:
    routes.Comparison(vid) -> [
      demo_api.fetch_comparison(
        store,
        vid,
        load_comparison_ids(),
        ApiReturnedComparisonDetails,
      ),
    ]
    _ -> []
  }
detail: Boot on /vacancies/v-*/edit seeds vacancy_edit_id but demo_entry_effects dispatches only notifications — no get_for_edit. modem.init doesn't dispatch at boot, so handle_browser_change's edit arm never runs; the deep-linked form cannot load.
recommended_fix: Add a routes.VacancyEdit(id) arm to demo_entry_effects firing demo_api.get_for_edit(store, id, ApiReturnedVacancyForEdit), mirroring handle_browser_change's edit arm.

title: Navigating to /demo re-seeds the store, silently discarding in-session demo mutations
detail: Mutations are threaded back into demo_store so follow-up fetches see them, yet any later /demo visit re-seeds from fixtures — a demo vacancy created or a status changed mid-session silently vanishes, contradicting the keep-the-store comments.
recommended_fix: In the routes.Demo BrowserChangedUrl arm, only seed when model.demo_store is None; reuse the live store (and skip re-entry fetches) when demo_mode is already True.

title: Entering demo clobbers a live landlord session; demo exit downgrades auth to NotAsked
evidence:
enter_demo overwrites auth with no guard for an existing session:
          auth: Success(landlord),
          csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token",

exit resets to NotAsked:
          case is_public_route(route) {
            True ->
              handle_browser_change(
                Model(
                  ..model,
                  demo_mode: False,
                  demo_store: None,
                  auth: NotAsked,
                ),

and check_session runs only in the non-demo boot branch:
    False -> #(
      base_model,
      effect.batch([
        modem.init(BrowserChangedUrl),
        auth_api.check_session(ApiReturnedSession),
detail: routes.Demo calls enter_demo unconditionally, so a logged-in landlord's real auth/csrf are replaced by the mock; after exiting the demo, auth is NotAsked and nothing re-runs check_session — a valid cookie session now hits a login wall.
recommended_fix: Preserve the pre-demo auth/csrf and restore them on demo exit (or dispatch auth_api.check_session on exit) instead of downgrading to NotAsked.

title: Unreachable routes.Demo arm in view_protected_page
evidence:
view_page intercepts Demo before the protected fallback:
+    routes.Demo -> view_demo_page(model)
     // Protected routes — show login if not authenticated
     _ ->

is_protected_route groups Demo with the public routes:
-    routes.Landing
+    routes.Demo
+    | routes.Landing

yet view_protected_page also handles it:
+    routes.Demo -> dashboard.view_dashboard(model)
     routes.Dashboard -> dashboard.view_dashboard(model)
detail: view_page routes Demo to view_demo_page before the protected branch, and is_protected_route(Demo) is False, so view_protected_page never receives Demo — that arm is dead and renders an unshelled dashboard if ever reached.
recommended_fix: Delete the routes.Demo -> dashboard.view_dashboard(model) arm from view_protected_page.

title: Demo ?payment/?extended guard arms discard the accumulated effect batch
detail: eff may already carry the consent-modal focus-trap uninstall batched earlier in handle_browser_change; the demo guard arms return modem.replace alone, silently dropping those accumulated effects — inconsistent with every sibling branch.
recommended_fix: Return effect.batch([eff, modem.replace(route_to_path(route), None, None)]) from the demo guard arms in both the payment and extended cases.
